data.name: Tree Soul Revelation
data.description: Your skin takes on the appearance and properties of a tree trunk. This bark-like skin grants you a +4 natural armor bonus to your Armor Class and DR 10/slashing. You also regrow any severed limbs except your head within 24 hours as per regenerate. Finally, once a day as a standard action, you can assume the form of a treant, as per plant shape III, for %1 minutes.|max(1,3+CHA)
